close_request_metadata.side_semantics: hedge_mode: `side` is the POSITION DIRECTION (long/short), not buy/sell. Closing a short requires side=sell + tradeSide=close.

failed_first_attempt.cause: First close attempt sent side='buy', which the venue read as a long position. The hedge_mode contract requires side=sell to close a short position.
failed_first_attempt.effect_on_position: none — rejected before allocation, position unchanged
failed_first_attempt.lesson: In hedge mode `side` selects the position side; buy/sell semantics apply only to one-way mode.
